questions.stem: A 28-year-old man is brought by his wife. He continues to hear internal voices, which are telling him that the police and the CBI are after him. On physical examination, although he is cooperative, you notice that he has a flat, blunt affect. You decide to start him to a medication that will treat both the positive and negative symptoms of schizophrenia, although you informed his wife that keep towel over pillow while sleeping. Which drug u planned?
